name: Claude Cowork 101 (Sana course)
summary: Company-wide onboarding to Claude Enterprise: why Superside moved to Claude, Chat vs Cowork vs Code, Projects/Files/Memory/Skills/Connectors/models, Cowork folder setup with About Me files, prompting & context, building Skills with /skill-creator, role-based use cases, responsible use and token hygiene.
how_to_use: Open the course in Sana. Key setup: install the Claude desktop app; create a 'Claude Cowork' folder with ABOUT ME / OUTPUTS / TEMPLATES; have Claude interview you to write about-me.md, my-company.md, avoid-ai-writing.md; add global instructions in Settings > General > Instructions for Claude; connect the parent folder in Cowork and star it; turn Memory on in Settings > Capabilities; default to Sonnet (low/medium effort).

name: The Claude Plugin for PMs (Sana course)
summary: Training for Project Managers on the Claude Project Management plugin + Superside Internal MCP: setup, the 9 skills (morning briefing, project status, client replies, quoting, project creation, hours, brief triage, plan publishing, closing), asking freely across ~80 tools, three recorded live sessions and a sandbox Superspace account.
how_to_use: Open the course; follow 'Getting set up' (install Superside Internal MCP connector + PM plugin from Customize > Plugins > Your Org; connect Asana, Slack, Notion); watch the three recorded sessions (Claude Basics, Meet the Skills, Full PM Lifecycle simulation); practise in the '104597 - INTERNAL - 4.3 ANNUAL' Superspace account.

name: How to Build Claude Artifacts (Sana workshop)
summary: Beginner workshop (tool requirement: Claude) on building Claude artifacts - working tools, mini apps and interactive docs in the chat window - and when an artifact beats a regular chat answer. Built live in the session; course holds the slide deck.
how_to_use: Open the course and follow the embedded Google Slides deck; build one artifact yourself.

name: Creative tools at Superside (new-joiner Sana course)
summary: New-joiner course on how tools work: individual vs centrally managed tools (AI tools, Figma, Canva, Claude, stock), what you get on day one (Claude, stock via SSO, Figma view), what's available on request (Figma edit, Krea, Flora, Canva, Bannerify, Weave), what you buy yourself, how to request, and the four guardrails incl. tools not approved by Legal (Kling, ByteDance tools, CapCut used directly).
how_to_use: Open the course; request seats/credits in #s-creative-tool-licensing-credit-requests (Creative Ops, ~12h response; in-tool access buttons are not monitored). Live source of truth: Notion 'Creative Tooling at Superside'.

name: Introduction to Krea (Sana course)
summary: Fast-track course for all creatives on Krea, Superside's primary generative AI tool: access, overview video, multi-model image and video generation (Kling 2.0 as go-to video model at the time), custom model training (Flux), dataset curation, image editing, enhancing/upscaling (incl. Topaz up to 16K/22K), and where to get support.
how_to_use: All creatives are invited automatically - accept the email invite and log in with Superside Google SSO (check spam; else ask in #-s-support-ai-enhanced). Support: #-s-support-ai-powered, AI workflows Figma board, AI-Powered Juice YouTube channel, Creative Workflow Finder GPT.

name: Creative Superside Brand Models (Sana course)
summary: Creative tutorial for Superside Brand Models (Superspace + Figma plugin): what a Brand Model is (5-50 images + description, no training, contextual), creating/editing models, combining up to 3 models, choosing base models (Nano Banana Pro/2, GPT Image 2) and 3K/4K output, publishing a model to a customer account, plus six use-case tutorials (setup, editing, product photography, style transformation, sketch-guided, vector).
how_to_use: In Figma: right-click > Manage plugins > search the Superside Brand Models plugin and use the INTERNAL version; log in with your Superside account. Create a model under Models > New model. Publish to a customer by assigning the model to an account, then toggle Published on the account's Brand Models tab in internal.superside.com. Support: #brand-models-support.

name: Superside Brand Models for AM/PMs (Sana course)
summary: AM/PM version of the Brand Models course: what Brand Models are, why to build them proactively for daily work and upsell, how they work in Superspace (Omnibox 'context' > use brand models / refer past projects), positioning (image layer of client context intelligence, not a standalone magic product), playground demo account and selling materials.
how_to_use: Request the Brand Model / Brand Brain playground demo account via the access sheet linked in 'Playground Access' (read the 'Read First' tab). Use the Superspace Omnibox > Context > Use brand models. Selling materials: Sales Pitch Guide, Brand Models client deck, Brand Brain client deck.

name: Claude Project Management (PM) plugin
summary: Org Claude plugin that connects Claude to live Superspace data (projects, briefs, quotes, accounts, client chat) via the Superside Internal MCP. ~80 tools in toolsets (Projects, Briefs, Assets, Quoting, Accounts, Memory, Staffing) plus 9 skills: /morning-briefing, /project-status, /compose-chat-message, /quoting, /create-and-submit-project, /logging-management-hours, /new-project (brief triage), /publish-project-plan, /close-project, and the always-on using-project-management skill. Works within your existing permissions; action skills wait for explicit confirmation.
how_to_use: 1) Claude app > Customize > Connectors > install 'Superside Internal MCP'. 2) Customize > Plugins > Browse > 'Your Org' tab > install the PM plugin. 3) Connect Asana, Slack and Notion connectors. Run skills with the slash command or plain language; schedule the morning briefing to Slack DM with /schedule in Cowork. Sandbox: Superspace account '104597 - INTERNAL - 4.3 ANNUAL'. Full tool catalog: Notion 'Claude Project Management plugin'.

name: Superside Internal MCP (connector)

how_to_use: Claude app > Customize > Connectors > find 'Superside Internal MCP' > install.

name: People Guru Claude plugin
summary: Claude plugin for people managers; the SAR resources recommend it to support review writing in walkthrough mode or reflection-partner mode (alongside the Notion 'SAR Review Guru' guide).
how_to_use: Install steps are not in the course; presumably via Claude > Customize > Plugins > Your Org (same as other org plugins). See Notion 'How to use the SAR Review Guru'.

name: Cowork 'About Me' folder setup (Claude 101 method)
summary: Standard Superside setup for Claude Cowork: a 'Claude Cowork' folder with ABOUT ME / OUTPUTS / TEMPLATES, interview-generated about-me.md, my-company.md and avoid-ai-writing.md (installed via a Cowork skill), and global instructions telling Claude to read ABOUT ME before every task and save deliverables to OUTPUTS/<project>.
how_to_use: Prompt Cowork: 'I want to create my about-me.md file - ask me questions to build it.' Repeat for my-company.md and avoid-ai-writing.md. Add global instructions under Settings > General > Instructions for Claude. Connect the parent folder (not a subfolder) and star it. Keep ABOUT ME lean (~1,500-2,000 words).

name: Superside AI Acceptable Use Policy (+ responsible-use rules)
summary: Company AI policy linked from Claude Cowork 101. Course guidance: Superside uses Claude's enterprise tier (conversation content not used for training), admins may see usage data for compliance, Cowork only sees folders you select, review every output before it reaches a client, you are responsible for what you send, and if you wouldn't send it to a personal email don't paste it into Claude. Only install Skills from trusted sources and read the .md files first.
how_to_use: Read the policy via the 'Responsible use' card in Claude Cowork 101 (also links Anthropic's usage policy).

name: Approved creative & AI tool stack (and how to request seats)
summary: From 'Creative tools at Superside': day one - Claude, Shutterstock/Artlist/Stocksy (SSO), Figma view. On request via #s-creative-tool-licensing-credit-requests - Figma edit (all Creatives), Krea (all Creatives; main AI generation platform), Flora (AI/video Creatives & AI bootcamp), Canva (PMs/Creatives per project), Bannerify (floating seats), Weave (limited, GM approval). Self-bought - Adobe CC, MS Office. AI tools are centrally managed so privacy/model-training settings meet customer and legal requirements.
how_to_use: Request in #s-creative-tool-licensing-credit-requests (stock: #s-stock-approval-requests; Figma/Canva teams: #s-figma-canva-team-set-up). Live list: Notion 'Creative Tooling at Superside'.

name: AI tools not approved for delivery (Kling, ByteDance, CapCut direct)
summary: Legal-reviewed guardrail: Kling, ByteDance tools and CapCut must not be used directly for Superside delivery. Those models are fine inside Superside-managed platforms (e.g. Krea, Flora) because licensing/data terms sit with the platform. Also: use Superside (not personal) AI accounts, no personal AI subscriptions for customer work, no mid-project vendor onboarding for centrally managed tools; check with the Risk team when unsure.
how_to_use: Check the live list in Notion 'Creative Tooling at Superside' or ask the Risk team before using a new tool.

name: Superside Brand Models (Figma/FigJam plugin)
summary: Superside's contextual image-model system: 5-50 images + description per model (no training; prompt is matched to the most relevant dataset images), combine up to 3 models, base models like Nano Banana Pro/2 and GPT Image 2, up to 4K, image inputs/editing. Available via the internal Figma plugin and the Superspace Omnibox; models are shared company-wide and can be published to customer accounts.
how_to_use: Figma: Manage plugins > Superside Brand Models (internal version) > log in. Publish: assign model to an account, then toggle Published on the account's Brand Models tab in internal.superside.com. Support #brand-models-support.

name: GenAI QC Master GPT + AI image QC checklist
summary: Custom GPT tuned for strict QC of generative-AI images (physical anomalies, textures/backgrounds, text/bias, realism); scores out of 10 and requires >8 to pass. Paired with an AI image QC checklist (also a Figma component) covering hands, eyes, teeth, hair, shadows, perspective, copyrighted content and bias.
how_to_use: Links inside the 'QC Tools' cards of Creative AI Project Management: Quality Control; upload an image and ask it to rate it.

name: AI PM Sidekick (guide)
summary: Guide for PMs showing, per service and workflow step, how and where AI can be applied, with considerations, real examples and copy-pasteable text for client briefs and internal scopes.
how_to_use: Linked from the 'AI PM Sidekick' module of CPM budgeting toolkit practice; questions in #s-brief-ai-powered.

name: Workflow Finder GPT

how_to_use: Linked from Intro to Krea (Sources of support) and Creative AI Skill Unlock; paste the brief and follow the suggested workflows.
